conventions.scope: Two independent no-gap full-original-output L/S/K validation rounds; wall n3 and K Exp1 n3 are unchanged
conventions.clock: Exclusive engine inference including summary once; first token belongs to prefill; tool gaps excluded
conventions.margin: candidate minus matching same-round L; negative is a lead. S j10/11, K j12/13 and both j20 are descriptive selections, not a new crossover algorithm
conventions.prediction: Frozen historical 11/13 prediction and residual remain separate from updated pooled reconstruction and actual crossover
conventions.sessions: Validation rep0 and rep1 are two physical sessions; cross-session residuals cannot isolate fit error from session variation
conventions.domain: Historical/new-high calibration remains2048..81664 and requires prompt+original_output-1 coverage; R5 adds no calibration
